The docs server has no resources or prompts, so I'll look for its tools.

Plan covers geo-api, relay-svc and tiles-svc. `search-api` isn't in it. Next I'll check live status with deeper history.

I deployed two regions and wrote `/app/rollout-2026.11.json` and `/app/STATUS.json`. Both files parse as valid JSON. I didn't re-read live status after the two deploys; each returned a new release id (`r-98`, `r-99`).

**Deployed now (06:30Z):**
- `relay-svc` to `prod-eu-west` with build `b-12`. Wave 2 was open, and Dublin was inside its 04:00–07:00 window.
- `tiles-svc` to `prod-us-east` with build `b-10`. Wave 3 was open, and New York was still inside the window that began Sunday 22:00 EST. That region's blackout is cancelled.

No other region could be deployed at this moment. Most were blocked by bake time or a closed window, and `prod-eu-central` is under an active blackout until 2026-11-03 00:00 local.

**Earliest times for the remaining regions (UTC):**

|---|---|---|---|

| `prod-au-east` | 2026-11-02T14:00:00Z | 2026-11-03T14:00:00Z | done |
| `prod-eu-central` | 2026-11-03T05:00:00Z | 2026-11-04T05:00:00Z | 2026-11-03T05:00:00Z |
| `prod-us-east` | 2026-11-03T03:00:00Z | 2026-11-04T03:00:00Z | deployed |
| `prod-us-west` | 2026-11-04T07:00:00Z | 2026-11-05T07:00:00Z | 2026-11-04T07:00:00Z |
| `prod-ap-east` | 2026-11-04T17:00:00Z | 2026-11-04T17:00:00Z | 2026-11-04T17:00:00Z |

`prod-sa-east` is done for all three services. `prod-eu-west` is done for `geo-api` and `tiles-svc`, and deployed for `relay-svc`.

For `prod-ap-east`, `2026-11-04T17:00:00Z` is 02:00 on 2026-11-05 in Tokyo. That is the first moment after the 2026-11-04 blackout ends.

I did not touch `staging` or `search-api`, and I rolled nothing back. I used the final plan and revision 4 of the runbook, not the draft plan.

`STATUS.json` has status `success`.
